notes: The gloss «- قال هناد عن عبد المجيد أبي عمرو -» (Hannad's version of Abd al-Majid) is left out: the same transmitter written with a kunya

The text names the Companion twice in succession with the names reversed («العداء بن خالد بن هوذة» then «خالد بن العداء بن هوذة»); they are not merged (rule 9), and which of them saw the Prophet is not settled
